metadata.name: GetDisputeCaseHistory
metadata.description: The purpose of this API is to get case history  of a dispute transaction.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Currency Code Ex. 840 = US Doller. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language ==  en: means use English ---- es: means Spanish Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Description - ID of transaction which is marked disputed. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 23654789 Condition: Either of TransactionID or CaseID is mandatory.

request_fields.name: CaseID
request_fields.description: Description - Case ID assigned to a Dispute Case. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 23654789 Condition: Either of TransactionID or CaseID is mandatory.

children.name: DisputeTransactionList
children.description: Array to provide Dispute life cycle details

children.name: CaseID
children.description: ID which is generated against the Dispute request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXX Example: 9856198

children.name: DisputeStage
children.description: Action on Dispute Transaction. Valid Values: Please refer appendix section 'Dispute Action'(Column 'Code'). Example: 0,9 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: DisputeAction
children.description: Action on Dispute Transaction. Valid Values: Please refer appendix section 'Dispute Action'(Column 'Value'). Example: Initiate Dispute, Initiate Chargeback Allowable Values: 100

children.name: DisputeReason
children.description: Reason through which Dispute resolution needs to take place. Valid Values: Please refer appendix section 'Dispute Reason'. Example: Fraud,Duplicate Processing Allowable Values: 100

children.name: OriginalTxnAmount
children.description: Transaction amount of original transaction. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 150.50

children.name: DisputeAmount
children.description: The amount for which the Dispute is raised on the Transaction. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 20.00

children.name: DisputeResolveAmount
children.description: Amount for which Dispute need to resolve. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 10.50

children.name: DisputeDate
children.description: This tag reflects the date of dispute Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 12/20/2019

children.name: DisputeTransactionID
children.description: Transaction ID generated for a Dispute request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 123456

children.name: UserID
children.description: User ID of the user who take action on the dispute case. Example: DisputeAdminOne Allowable Values: 128

children.name: Memo
children.description: The note capture by the user. Valid Values: A-Z,0-9 Example: This is a test note. Allowable Values: 400

children.name: ChargebackErrorCode
children.description: Declined Chargeback Code. Example: 0 Allowable Values: 5

children.name: ChargebackErrorMessage
children.description: Declined Chargeback error message. Allowable Values: 1000

children.name: RebillAmount
children.description: Re bill Amount Valid Values:0-9 Example: 15.25

children.name: ChargebackAccepted
children.description: Flag to describe if Chargeback is raised and accepted for the dipsute transaction or not. Allowable Values: 3

children.name: NetworkConvertedDispAmt
children.description: Network Converted Dispute Amount Valid Values:0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 10.50

children.name: IssuerCaseId
children.description: CaseID retruned from MasterCard Valid Values:0-9 Format: XX.XX Example: 10.50

children.name: PreArbCaseStatus
children.description: PreArbCaseStatus Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXX Example: Closed

children.name: PreArbArbiCaseStatus
children.description: PreArbCaseStatus Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXX Example: Closed
